title: An authenticated attacker must reach the Edge file APIs through the Leader or directly on an Edge node (CVE-2026-115903)
description: CVE-2026-115903 is a vulnerability affecting managed Edge deployments with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). An authenticated attacker with Read Only access can reach the Edge file APIs via the Leader or directly on an Edge node. The attacker can disclose files readable by the Edge process according to its operating system permissions. This vulnerability does not allow modification or denial of service but can lead to unauthorized information disclosure.
